Hi Sarah / Cumulus team —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our notes, Cumulus is preparing for a term renewal and is interested in a modest capacity uplift (~20% token throughput) plus exploring a longer commit (18–24 months) to secure better unit economics. I wanted to kick off the formal coordination and propose an initial timeline and owners so we can keep momentum.

High-level proposal / asks from Redwood:
- Timeline: QBR + contract amendment in the next 10 business days, PO by Oct 15, new capacity effective Nov 1.
- Ownership: Diego (AM) for commercial/terms, Marissa (CS) for onboarding/staffing, Karthik (Solutions) for sizing/architecture.
- Required items from Cumulus: expected 90-day throughput forecast (avg and 95p), any compliance evidence requests (SOC 2 / encryption / retention), and procurement timing expectations.

Proposed QBR slots (PT):
- Mon Sep 29 11:00–12:00
- Tue Sep 30 09:00–10:00

I attached a mutual action plan draft to this thread to capture milestones and owners. Please let me know which QBR slot works and share the throughput forecast when you have it.

Attachments: [Attachment: Cumulus_MUTUAL_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez

Diego / team —

Thanks — tagging in for staffing and capacity planning. Quick internal checklist and recommended approach:

1) Sizing + delivery model
- For a 20% uplift and multi-year commit, I recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) with burst headroom. That gives us predictable latency and a clearer unit-cost reduction to justify the longer term.
- Karthik: can you confirm if the current model variants used by Cumulus are compatible with the reserved pool and whether any quantization changes are needed?

2) Compliance evidence
- We can share the RDW SOC 2 Q2 report and a short one-pager on retention policies. I’ll route RDW_SOC2_Report_Q2_2029.pdf to this thread.

3) Commercial
- Diego / Laura: I drafted a price uplift quote for 20% capacity and a two-year staircase. Attached — this is a starting point for negotiation.

4) QBR agenda (30–45m)
- Exec handoff (10m)
- Current usage & forecast (10m)
- Ops & governance (10m)
- Contract timeline & next steps (5m)

Next actions I’ll take: send SOC2 report link, upload the draft quote to the shared drive, and spin up the amendment skeleton for legal review.

Attachments: [Attachment: quote-20290921.pdf (pdf)]
